model: KNSLM boiler control (KN2 / KN4 / rAy series)
applies_to: KNSLM boiler control (KN2/KN4/rAy series), register list V1.10; registers marked 2.70+ need firmware 2.70 or later.
summary: The KNSLM is the boiler control named in this Mestek register list for the KN2, KN4 and rAy series; one connected (master) boiler can report on up to 15 member boilers. Over Modbus a BMS sets heat demand, system and outdoor-reset setpoints and the clock through holding registers, and reads header, supply, return and outdoor temperatures plus per-boiler status flags, runtimes, cycle counts and modulation through input registers.

addressing.note: Registers are listed in Modicon form (40001 holding, 30001 input). Request 40001 as holding address 0 and 30001 as input address 0.

source.title: KNSLM (KN2/KN4/rAy) Series Boiler - Modbus Registers
source.pages: pp. 1-2 (read/write registers), pp. 3-11 (read-only registers), pp. 12-15 (status flags appendix)

notes: The register list is a Mestek, Inc. document; it names no other brand. No public copy on a Mestek site was found; the link is an unaltered copy hosted by a gateway supplier.
Runtime and cycle counters are two 16-bit registers, high word first: value = high x 65536 + low (ABCD).
Several registers hold 8-bit or 1-bit values in a 16-bit register; they are listed as UINT16.
Unsigned 8-bit values (setpoints, clock fields) are listed as UINT16; the list does not say which byte of the register holds them.

Left out: the system modulation at 30002 (listed as 8-bit with scale 0.01 but range 0-100 %, which do not agree) and the low outdoor air temperature setpoint 40009 (8-bit signed; how it sits in the 16-bit register is not stated).
Boiler 01 is the master (connected) boiler; boilers 02-16 are cascade members 01-15.

registers.name: Setpoint timer
registers.description: BMS failsafe countdown; at zero the boiler reverts to its saved local setpoint.

registers.name: Outdoor reset shutdown setpoint
registers.description: Outdoor temperature at which the boiler shuts down, 40-100 °F.

registers.name: Reset water temp at high outdoor temp
Reset water temp at low outdoor temp
Operating setpoint
registers.description: Active setpoint: heating, DHW, outdoor reset or 4-20 mA; 40-220 °F.

integration.summary: Write the system setpoint (40003) and heat demand (40001), and keep reloading the setpoint timer (40002) so the boiler does not fall back to its local setpoint. Poll input registers 30001-30006 for system temperatures and the boiler status blocks for alarms.
integration.enable: Not described in this register list; set up Modbus in the boiler control as per the boiler manual.
integration.watchdog: Setpoint timer 40002: if it counts down to zero the control assumes the BMS has failed and reloads its saved local setpoint. Writing any read/write register reloads it to 60 s if it is below 60 (firmware 2.70+; older firmware only on a setpoint write).
quirks: Writing the clock is a two-step operation: load 40010-40016, then write 1 to 40017.
gotchas: Temperatures are in °F with 0.01 resolution for the system sensors but whole °F for setpoints and DHW values.

verified.method: independent re-check of every register against the source PDF
